title: Lesson 8: Sharding & Consistent Hashing — js-tools
desc: Why sharding is the last step, not the first; modulo hashing going from 4 to 5 shards forces 79.97% of the data to migrate while consistent hashing moves only 18.78%, and both match theory to two decimal places; without virtual nodes one shard receives 66 keys and another 25,465; a skewed shard key gives a better p50 and p95 but a p99 10.3 times worse; and the first run of the measurement produced the exact opposite result because both shards shared one machine's CPU.
